name: Recraft Image
author: hearth-team
description: Design-focused image + vector generation via Recraft.ai. Unique among providers: native SVG / vector output, brand-controllable style presets, icon and logo modes. Pass `style` for one of recraft's 30+ presets (realistic_image, digital_illustration, vector_illustration, icon).

family.name: AI Image Family
family.description: Headshots, inpainting, wardrobe swap, logos, social posts. Pick a provider (OpenAI / KIE / Higgsfield / Replicate / fal / Stability / Recraft / Ideogram) and your favorite task — sub-skills route through whichever provider you've configured.
